import random, collections
inp=[[0,9,3,3,1,5],[7,5,3,3,1,7],[3,3,3,3,9,2],[2,4,0,7,3,3],[4,3,5,3,3,3],[3,3,3,3,3,3]]
vals=sum(inp,[])*4
prefix=sum(inp,[])
rem=vals.copy()
for x in prefix: rem.remove(x)
random.Random(42).shuffle(rem)
out=[prefix[i*6:(i+1)*6] for i in range(6)]
for r in range(6,12): out.append(rem[(r-6)*12:(r-5)*12])
print(out)
